name: Table
summary: Displays structured data with selectable rows and columns.

obligations: Expose table, header, row, column, and cell semantics.
Expose row selection and keyboard focus.
Expose sort state on sortable column headers.

behavior: Keyboard navigation moves through rows and cells.
Controlled and uncontrolled Core key selections are supported.

With onRowAction set and selectionMode multiple, a click or Enter on a row runs the action while nothing is selected, so pointer users start a selection with Space or a selection affordance in the row content.

A column with sortable: true has a sortable header. Activating it by click, Enter, or Space reports sortChange with the column and direction, toggling between ascending and descending; sortDescriptor sets the sorted column.

A sorted column shows a chevron after its label, up for ascending and down for descending. An unsorted sortable header shows an upward chevron only on pointer hover or keyboard focus. Every sortable header reserves the chevron slot, so labels never shift, and non-sortable headers show no chevron.
A disabled Table sets data-disabled on its root, ignores sort changes, and shows no hover or focus sort hint.
accessibility: Expose table, header, row, column, and cell semantics.
Expose row selection and keyboard focus.
Expose aria-sort on sortable column headers; the sort chevron is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
